content:
Once your return is received and passes inspection at the warehouse (which takes 2–3 business days), refunds are issued depending on how you paid:

* **Credit / debit card:** 5–7 business days back to your card
* **UPI:** 3–5 business days to your UPI ID
* **Cash on delivery:** 7–10 business days via bank transfer or store credit (a colleague will collect your bank details securely for this)
* **Store credit:** Issued immediately
